fluff.overview: Federated Suns infantry benefit from one of the strongest industrial bases in the Inner Sphere, with AFFS quartermasters able to supply platoons with standardized equipment and ammunition from a logistics network that few rival states can match. Foot infantry remain the backbone of AFFS planetary garrisons, cheap enough to deploy in numbers across the Federated Suns' vast territory and reliable enough to hold ground that BattleMech forces cannot permanently occupy. These Xenoplanetary Condition Troops are trained and equipped for combat in hostile environments where standard infantry cannot operate effectively, carrying specialized survival gear alongside laser weapons that allow them to fight in extreme temperatures, toxic atmospheres, or unusual gravity conditions.
